# criblio_monitor (Resource)

Monitor Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "criblio_monitor" "example" {
  id         = "cpu-high"
  name       = "CPU High"
  dataset_id = "metrics"
  enabled    = true
  type       = "threshold"

  query = {
    A = {
      mode   = "promql"
      promql = "sum(rate(cpu_usage[5m]))"
    }
  }

  expr    = []
  silence = []

  firing_condition = {
    fire_delay  = 60
    clear_delay = 60
  }

  firing_rule = {
    label = "A"
    threshold = [{
      severity      = "critical"
      limit         = 90
      included_tags = []
      excluded_tags = []
    }]
  }

  aetos_metadata = {}

  monitor_policy_notification_config = {
    enabled = false
    type    = "policy"
    config = [{
      id                    = "default-policy"
      order                 = 0
      conditions            = []
      template_target_pairs = []
    }]
  }

  priority_scalar_value = {
    value = "P2"
  }

  team_scalar_value = {
    value = "ops"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `dataset_id` (String) Default dataset used for query execution and alert history storage. Per-query overrides are set via the query's datasetId.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the monitor is active and evaluated.
- `expr` (Attributes List) Query expressions evaluated to produce the monitor's series. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--expr))
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the monitor.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name for the monitor.
- `query` (Attributes Map) Monitor queries keyed by query label. Each query is inheritable from a linked profile. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--query))
- `silence` (List of String) IDs of silence windows that suppress this monitor's alerts.
- `type` (String) Monitor type, which determines the detection strategy (for example threshold, change, anomaly, outlier, forecast, or logs).

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional human-readable description of the monitor.
- `search_mode` (String) Logs monitors only. Distinguishes authoring a fresh search ('new') from selecting a saved one ('saved'). Defaults to 'new' when omitted; ignored for non-logs monitor types.
- `template_params` (Map of String) Template parameter bindings keyed by query label. Baseline values come from the query's shared configs; non-empty values act as user overrides.
- `unit` (String) Optional unit label applied to the monitor's values.

### Optional

- `anomaly_config` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--anomaly_config))

<a id="nestedatt--anomaly_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `anomaly_config`

Optional:

- `algorithm` (String) Anomaly detection algorithm. Defaults to <code>basic</code> when absent.
- `auto_selection_strategy` (String) Candidate selection strategy for auto-seasonality.<br/> <br><code>centering</code> == Rank by out-of-sample centering gain (default) <br><code>spread</code> == Rank by seasonal spread reduction against the global band.
- `baseline_window` (String)
- `minimum_cycles` (Integer) Minimum number of complete seasonal cycles required before the model can fire.
- `minimum_samples` (Integer) Minimum number of samples required before the detector starts firing.
- `minimum_seasonal_coverage` (Number) Minimum share (0 to 1) of the expected samples a phase must have before its model is trusted.
- `minimum_seasonal_spread_improvement` (Number) Minimum seasonal spread reduction that a candidate must demonstrate before auto-seasonality selects it. Applies only when <code>seasonality</code> is <code>auto</code> and <code>autoSelectionStrategy</code> is <code>spread</code>.
- `minimum_seasonal_validation_improvement` (Number) Minimum out-of-sample improvement that a seasonal candidate (hourly, daily, or weekly) must demonstrate before auto-seasonality selects it. Applies only when <code>seasonality</code> is <code>auto</code>. Default is <code>0.05</code>. Valid range is <code>0</code> to <code>0.9</code>.
- `noise_floor` (Number) Absolute lower bound for the model's spread, which prevents zero-width bands.
- `seasonality` (String) Seasonality mode for the anomaly model. Defaults to <code>none</code> when absent.
- `threshold_direction` (String)
- `timezone` (String) Named IANA timezone used to assign timestamps to seasonal phases.

<a id="nestedatt--expr"></a>
### Nested Schema for `expr`

Required:

- `label` (String) Result label for the query expression. The auto-managed expression uses <code>Alert Query</code>.
- `query_labels` (List of String) Query labels referenced in the expression's <code>text</code>, computed at write time.
- `text` (String) Free-form math expression combining query labels. Authoritative representation of the expression.

Optional:

- `dataset_id` (String) Per-expression dataset override. Falls back to the monitor's <code>datasetId</code> when absent.
- `left` (String) Deprecated legacy left-hand query or expression label for a binary operation. Read only by legacy structured expressions.
- `operation` (String) (Deprecated) Operation type for structured expressions.
- `right` (String) Deprecated legacy right-hand query or expression label for a binary operation. Read only by legacy structured expressions.
- `scalar` (Number) Deprecated legacy numeric scalar for a query-scalar binary operation. Read only by legacy structured expressions.

<a id="nestedatt--query"></a>
### Nested Schema for `query`

Required:

- `mode` (String) Query authoring mode: <code>builder</code> for the visual builder or <code>promql</code> for raw PromQL.
- `promql` (String) PromQL query string that the monitor evaluates.

Optional:

- `builder` (Attributes) Structured builder representation of this query. Present when authored via the visual builder UI. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--query--builder))
- `dataset_id` (String) Per-query dataset override. Falls back to the monitor's <code>datasetId</code> when absent.
- `display_name` (String) User-editable display label for the query card. Defaults to the stable query key.
- `logs_builder` (Attributes) Structured builder fields for a logs-mode query. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--query--logs_builder))
- `params` (Map of String) Template parameter bindings applied to the query before evaluation.

<a id="nestedatt--query--builder"></a>
### Nested Schema for `query.builder`

Required:

- `aggregation` (String) Aggregation operator applied to the metric series.
- `evaluation_window` (Attributes) Evaluation window over which the metric query is evaluated. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--query--builder--evaluation_window))
- `group_by` (List of String) Label keys to group the aggregated metric results by.
- `label_filters` (Attributes List) Label filters applied to the metric query in builder mode. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--query--builder--label_filters))
- `metric` (String) Name of the metric to query in builder mode.
- `units` (String) Unit label applied to the query's values.

<a id="nestedatt--query--builder--evaluation_window"></a>
<a id="nestedatt--query--logs_builder--evaluation_window"></a>
### Nested Schema for `query.builder.evaluation_window`

Required:

- `unit` (String) Time unit for the evaluation window magnitude.
- `value` (Integer) Numeric magnitude of the evaluation window, paired with <code>unit</code>.

<a id="nestedatt--query--builder--label_filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `query.builder.label_filters`

Required:

- `key` (String) Label key to filter on.
- `op` (String) Comparison operator for the label filter. Supports PromQL semantics: <code>=</code>, <code>!=</code>, <code>=</code>, <code>!</code>.
- `value` (String) Value to match against the label, interpreted according to the operator.

<a id="nestedatt--query--logs_builder"></a>
### Nested Schema for `query.logs_builder`

Required:

- `dataset` (String) Dataset to query for log events.
- `evaluation_window` (Attributes) Evaluation window over which the logs query is evaluated. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--query--logs_builder--evaluation_window))
- `group_by` (List of String) Label keys to group the aggregated log results by.
- `operator` (String) Aggregation operator applied to the log events.

Optional:

- `field` (String) Field to aggregate over. Required for operators other than <code>count_all</code>.
- `parent_search` (String) Optional parent search that scopes the logs query.
- `saved_search_id` (String) Identifier of a saved search to run instead of an authored query.

<a id="nestedatt--firing_rule--overrides"></a>
### Nested Schema for `firing_rule.overrides`

Required:

- `enabled` (Boolean) If <code>true</code>, apply the override rule. Otherwise, <code>false</code>.
- `excluded_tags` (List of String) Tag filters that exclude matching series from the override.
- `included_tags` (List of String) Tag filters that scope the override to only the matching series.
- `name` (String) Name of the override rule.
- `threshold` (Attributes List) Severity thresholds evaluated for the override rule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--firing_rule--overrides--threshold))

Optional:

- `show_on_chart` (Boolean) If <code>true</code>, draw the override's threshold lines on the monitor preview chart. Otherwise, <code>false</code>.

<a id="nestedatt--firing_rule--overrides--threshold"></a>
<a id="nestedatt--firing_rule--threshold"></a>
### Nested Schema for `firing_rule.overrides.threshold`

Required:

- `excluded_tags` (List of String) Tag filters that exclude matching series from the threshold.
- `included_tags` (List of String) Tag filters that scope the threshold to only the matching series.
- `limit` (Number) Threshold value that the metric is compared against using <code>operator</code>.
- `severity` (String) Severity assigned when the threshold's condition is met: <code>critical</code>, <code>warning</code>, or <code>info</code>.

Optional:

- `operator` (String) Comparison operator applied to the threshold limit. Defaults to <code>gt</code> when absent.
- `std_deviations` (Number) Per-severity anomaly sensitivity, expressed as a number of standard deviations from the baseline.
- `times_triggered` (Integer) Number of consecutive evaluations the condition must hold before firing. Defaults to 1 when absent.

<a id="nestedatt--monitor_policy_notification_config--config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `monitor_policy_notification_config.config`

Required:

- `conditions` (List of String)
- `id` (String) Unique identifier.
- `order` (Number) Evaluation order of this policy. Policies with lower numbers are evaluated first.
- `template_target_pairs` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--monitor_policy_notification_config--config--template_target_pairs))

Optional:

- `disabled` (Boolean) If <code>true</code>, this policy is skipped during evaluation. Otherwise, <code>false</code>.
- `final` (Boolean) If <code>true</code>, this is the last policy to apply; no policies below it are evaluated or combined. Otherwise, <code>false</code>.
- `group_by_labels` (List of String)
- `wait_to_group` (Number) How long, in minutes, to wait after the first alert before sending a Notification, allowing the system to group similar alerts.

<a id="nestedatt--monitor_policy_notification_config--config--template_target_pairs"></a>
<a id="nestedatt--monitor_target_notification_config--config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `monitor_policy_notification_config.config.template_target_pairs`

Required:

- `target_id` (String) The <code>id</code> of the Notification target to send the Notification to.
- `template_id` (String) The <code>id</code> of the Notification template to use.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = criblio_monitor.my_criblio_monitor
  id = "example"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import criblio_monitor.my_criblio_monitor "example"
```
